name: Satu
soft_passes: #3 silhouette: signature diagonal slice is negative space, closes up when filled solid black — mark survives as a bar+foot blob
#4 16px squint: holds clean (no smear) but slice is lost and the two elements merge into one
#2 grid: mark sits slightly high/upper-weighted vs optical centre, within tolerance
failures: #10 variant robustness: composition is white-ground-dependent — the signature slice IS the white ground bleeding through the glyph, so it disappears under dark/clear/tinted appearances; no appearance layers
light_model: Soft upper-left, expressed only as a gentle charcoal gradient across the glyph (#3B3B3B upper-left -> #262626 lower-right); no internal cast shadows; the diagonal white slice is the sole specular-glint cue.
layer_stack: charcoal glyph (horizontal capsule bar + descending rounded tab)
diagonal white negative-space slice (ground showing through)
devices: diagonal negative-space slice cleaving the mark (reads as a glass glint)
monochrome austerity — white + charcoal, zero accent (mnmls studio signature)
capsule-terminal geometry — all stroke ends fully rounded, one radius language
subtle left-lit charcoal gradient within the glyph
rhymes_hint: Swiss/International monochrome monogram marks — black-on-white abstract-letterform icons (Vercel/Linear-register studio marks); a 'reductive monochrome' style family
notes: 512x512 web render (half of 1024 master) — clean edges, transparent margins (alpha=0), no baked drop shadow, so HIG-correct pre-masked squircle; fine gradient nuance may be softened by downscale. Glyph is abstract (not a literal letter) though it flirts with a stylised 7/F/r; app name 'satu' = 'one' in Malay/Indonesian, numeral reference is plausible but unconfirmed. Icon<->product palette incoherence: icon is monochrome-austere but the app (per cover) is playful/colorful (blue-purple gradient chrome, green Done accent, lofi cat+duck illustration) — the icon signals the studio (mnmls minimalism), not the subject. Era-lag finding: Big Sur unified language shipped into the macOS 26 Liquid Glass era with no translucency/refraction/appearance variants, which is the root cause of the #10 failure. First 'reductive monochrome' candidate for icon clustering — needs >=2 more independent icons before any canon promotion.
